starttime.description: The start time, in datetime format, for which the data was retrieved.

endtime.description: The end time, in datetime format, for which the data was retrieved.

interval.description: The interval (window size) for which the metric data was returned.

namespace.description: The namespace of the metrics being queried.

resourceregion.description: The region of the resource being queried for metrics.

resourceid.description: The resource ID for which metrics were retrieved.
